name: Jennings Branch near Churchville

impacts.statement: All roads in Churchville that cross Jennings Branch (Route 42, Route 835, and Hangers Mill Road) are flooded with water covering all three bridges. Numerous homes, businesses, and other structures are flooded; some with multiple feet of water inside.

Hangers Mill Road is flooded and water covers the bridge at that location. Water is approaching homes, businesses, and other structures in Churchville. Access roads upstream of Churchville begin to flood.

Water approaches the lowest point of a building near the intersection of Route 42 and Route 835 in Churchville. An access road behind two churches has around two feet of water covering it, and water approaches Hangers Mill Road downstream of Churchville.
An access road behind two churches in Churchville is flooded, along with other lowlands near the stream.
Overbank flooding begins in the vicinity of Route 835 in Churchville.

hydronotes.statement: Stage may be affected by ice.

forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
